name: Required keywords
description: Case-insensitive substring coverage: matched configured keywords divided by configured keywords.

name: Forbidden keywords
description: Full credit only when none of the configured keywords appear, ignoring case; otherwise zero.

name: Required phrases
description: Case-insensitive substring coverage across the configured phrases.

name: Forbidden phrases
description: Full credit only when none of the configured phrases appear, ignoring case; otherwise zero.

name: Exact match
description: Case-sensitive comparison of the entire response, preserving whitespace.

name: Contains text
description: Case-sensitive substring presence in the response.

name: Case insensitive match
description: Unicode case-folded comparison of the entire response.

name: Minimum characters
description: Partial credit equals character count divided by the target, capped at one; a zero target is satisfied.

name: Maximum characters
description: Binary check that the complete response does not exceed the character limit.

name: Minimum sentences
description: Partial credit for the target count of punctuation-separated sentences; this is a heuristic.
